text:
Talia: heads up, I'm flying into NYC early Monday and will be in the SoHo office. Flight gets in ~5:30am — anyone know anywhere close that's open that early for a bagel or strong coffee? also need vegan/gluten-free recs.

Mike: not many proper shops that open that early in SoHo. A few options: 1) 'Corner Bodega' on Canal (card only) — they do bagels at 5am sometimes, depending on delivery. 2) 'Cafe Luma' opens at 6am weekdays, great coffee + GF muffin.

Ravi: +1 to Corner Bodega if you want ultra-early. It's basically a bodega but they fold bagels fresh at dawn. Not fancy but reliable.

Jen: If you can wait till 6am, 'Sunnyside Bagels' on Prince has a decent GF bagel and oat milk latte. It's a 7-min walk from the office.

Sam: for vegan-specific, 'Greenwich Pantry' (on Wooster) has a vegan everything bagel and avocado smash. Opens 7am tho.

Talia: ugh 7am might be late for me — meeting starts 7:30am. Any airport recs? flying into JFK.

Mike: at JFK, Terminal 4 has Joe & The Juice and a Pret that open early — not the best bagels but solid coffee and avocado toast.

Ravi: if you want ramen after travel (late night previous day), 'Little Ramen' in East Village stays open to 2-3am on weekends. Not SoHo but taxi-able.

Jen: alternately, if you land weird, bring an instant fix: there's a mini kitchen in the SoHo office with electric kettle + mugs — ops-bot can confirm stock.

ops-bot: quick note: SoHo pantry has limited GF spreads but we keep oat milk + a few granola bars in Team Supplies. If you'd like us to stock a specific item, ping Facilities.

Talia: thanks all — timeline: land 5:30, aim to be at office by 7. If anyone's free could we meet for a quick coffee at 6:15? (I can try Cafe Luma).

Mike: I'll try to swing by — fingers crossed traffic is kind. :crossed_fingers:

Ravi: if you can't find a legit bagel, bring a backup snack. airports are usually the safe bet. :airplane:

Jen: FYI here's a tiny directions snippet if you want to map them quickly:
```
From SoHo office (Broad & Prince):
- Cafe Luma: 2 min walk east on Prince
- Sunnyside Bagels: head north on Broadway, left on Prince, ~7 min
- Corner Bodega: walk south to Canal, ~10-12 min or quick rideshare
```

Talia: perfect, appreciate it! See you Monday. :wave:
